# GenerateOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for the asynchronous generate and save methods.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`signal`](#signal): Cancels the operation.

### `signal`

```typescript
signal?: AbortSignal | undefined
```

*optional*

Cancels the operation. Checked before generation starts and between its stages (font loading, image and SVG preparation, serialization); when aborted, the promise rejects with the signal's reason.
